Pree is on the Central team, and I found nothing showing Pree owns Thornbury. If Pree does own it, I'll draft the mail straight away. If not, once I have the rate I'll ask June or Anselm, and I'll draft the mail once one of them says yes.

I haven't filed an approval request yet, because I need the actual figure to say what's being approved. The mail goes to Pree's pemberline.com address, so Ruth doesn't need to approve outside mail.

One mistake on my part: my reply refers to Pree as "she," which I shouldn't have assumed.
